report.title: Memos Detail Sidebar renders values as [object Object]
report.body: ### Pre-submission Checklist - [x] I have searched the existing issues and this bug has not been reported yet - [x] I have tested this issue on the [demo site](https://demo.usememos.com) or the latest version ### Where did you encounter this bug? Demo site (demo.usememos.com) ### Memos Version v0.25.3 ### Bug Description Opening the Memo Detail page shows the sidebar with data and tag information, the dates however are rendered as `[object Object]` The alt text on the posted time (the one under the username, e.g. `2 minutes ago`) does however show a date, so some time information seems to exist. Furthermore the protobuf message yielded from the `GetMemo` API endpoint does not seem to contain any datetime information: `` ### Steps to Reproduce 1. Post a Memo 2. Open the Memo detail view 3. Observe the sidebar widget ### Expected Behavior I expected the time information in the Memo Detail Sidebar to be rendered properly ### Screenshots & Additional Context - Browser: Firefox - OS: Linux

preconditions: the signed-in user has no memos yet
steps: Type "do tags nest?" into the memo editor on the home page
Click the Save button to post the memo
Click the newly posted memo's timestamp (or open the memo) to open its detail page
Look at the detail sidebar on the memo detail page
plan.expected: the sidebar on the memo detail page shows the memo's dates as readable date/time text, and the text "[object Object]" does not appear anywhere in the sidebar
plan.reported_actual: The dates in the Memo Detail sidebar are rendered as the literal text [object Object], while the hover/alt text on the posted time under the username shows a date
missing: assumed: memo content is arbitrary since the report says only 'Post a Memo'; used the text 'do tags nest?' visible in the pasted API payload
assumed: the sidebar is the one shown on the memo detail page at a desktop width; narrower widths may hide it
Which exact sidebar labels show [object Object] (created, updated, etc.) is not stated in text, only in a screenshot
Is the bug reproducible on versions other than v0.25.3?
plan.summary: Memo detail sidebar shows dates as [object Object] instead of formatted date/time
